reuse.why: Introduces one getMonthWideTargetCategories selection used by every month-wide action, and routes the averaging actions through the existing setNMonthAvg instead of their own copies.

duplication.why: Replaces three copy-pasted category queries and three near-identical loops with one selection function and one setMonthWideAverage helper; copyPreviousMonth drops its own hidden check in favour of the shared set.

placement.why: The eligibility query and the averaging helper live in budget/actions.ts beside the month-wide actions that use them.

scope.why: Focused on month-wide actions; consolidating set3MonthAvg onto setNMonthAvg goes slightly beyond the request but stays within the same functions.

maintainability.why: A single place defines the exclusions; copyPreviousMonth's membership check against a separately fetched id set is a little indirect and getBudgetData still selects the hidden columns it no longer needs.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth, setZero and the 3/6/12-month averages all take their targets from getMonthWideTargetCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: Duplicated loops and queries are removed, not reshaped.

one_place.where: getMonthWideTargetCategories (server/budget/actions.ts) holds the hidden, hidden-group and saved-template exclusions; setZero, setMonthWideAverage (3/6/12) and copyPreviousMonth (via its id set) all use it.
